item.title: Good Morning Family - 28 October 2026
item.description:
Good morning Walkers!
Hello everyone!
Today is Wednesday, the 28 October.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be cloudy, with a low of 6 degrees and a top of 17 degrees.
There is about a 2 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is O.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter O?
. . . . . . . . . .
